mapper.select: SELECT id, blog_id, author_type, author_id, content, parent_comment_id, created_at, updated_at FROM blog_comments WHERE blog_id = #{blogId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_comments (id, blog_id, author_type, author_id, content, parent_comment_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{blogId}, #{authorType}, #{authorId}, #{content}, #{parentCommentId})
